title: Nice fragrance; has a multitude of uses to freshen up an area…I think????
text:
Nice fragrance; has a multitude of uses to freshen up an area…I think????. There are five air fresheners in this set or perhaps they are "insect repeliennt" if one reads the PIG LATIN on the box (see photo).

The sachets smell nice but once I open the package the fragrance is not my favorite. I like it but do not love it. There is a plastic "hook" that gets fed into the slot on the package so that this can be hung (see photo). This can also be put in a drawer, in the trunk of a car, on a clothing rod,  etc.

The current price of $9.99 is slightly expensive for this as it comes to $2 per packet. I believe packets like these go for $1.50 at the local store.

In summary, I believe these are air fresheners that absorb or cover odors. They are not too strong and have a pleasant scent even though it is not my favorite. I hope it is not an insect repellent. The vendor needs to hire someone to write the instructions in good English on the package so that mistakes like these are not made.
